responsibility: Implements generation of Ada package specifications from C-family front-end entities. It walks collected declarations, types, functions, variables, and user macros originating from a source file, converts GCC tree nodes and selected preprocessor constructs into Ada syntax, tracks package/with dependencies and overloaded names, and writes the resulting .ads file; it also accepts callbacks from the C or C++ front end for file reference collection and C++-specific node queries.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the Ada spec dumper: unlike c-ada-spec.h, it contains the tree/macro traversal, Ada syntax rendering, source-reference collection, and .ads file emission logic, while the header only defines the callback enum and declares the public entry points.
